description: Execute an ERP master-data conversion for a migration from a legacy ERP (Oracle E-Business Suite) to SAP S/4HANA. The master data includes 200K materials, 150K customers, 100K vendors, and 5M transactional history records. The conversion must follow: extract (export data from Oracle EBS — full extract for master data, filtered extract for transactional history), transform/validate (convert data types, map Oracle chart-of-accounts to SAP G/L account structure, validate mandatory fields, deduplicate), map/migrate (load data into SAP via LSMW or Migration Cockpit — materials first, then customers/vendors, then transactional history), reconcile (verify record counts, financial totals, and key reports match between Oracle EBS and SAP), and verify (business users validate sample records, run trial balance). A rollback plan must exist (revert SAP to pre-conversion state, re-import from Oracle EBS backup). Risk factors: chart-of-accounts mapping errors affect financial reporting, material master data errors affect production planning, and transactional history volume (5M records) affects conversion runtime. Tools available: SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW, Oracle EBS API, SQL, Excel (validation), SAP Data Services.
